en.title: Game Resource Reverse Engineering
en.sub: Plants vs. Zombies 2, Chinese version, Android

did: Inspected Android native library (.so) files with MT Manager to find encryption-related strings and constants associated with the game's resource files.
Studied how the Rijndael cipher uses a key and an IV.
Used existing tools and recovered key material to decrypt and inspect RTON game data, then read the data that could be opened.
Explored binary file formats, resource encoding and game data protection through independent experimentation.
groups.tools: MT Manager; existing decryption tools (names no longer remembered).
groups.result: Decrypted RTON resource files and viewed the readable data inside.
groups.gaps: This was personal learning, not employment. I make no claim of a custom decryption algorithm, of breaking Rijndael/AES, or of a vulnerability confirmed by the publisher. Exact steps are no longer remembered, so none are reconstructed. Keys, IVs and proprietary game data are not published, and other authors' findings are not claimed as mine.
groups.proof: None published on this site yet.

did: 用 MT Manager 查看 Android 原生库（.so）文件，找到与游戏资源加密相关的字符串和常量。

借助已有工具，并找回密钥材料，解密 RTON 游戏资源文件，查看其中可读取的数据。
通过独立实验，了解二进制文件格式、资源编码与游戏数据保护。
groups.tools: MT Manager；已有的解密工具（名称已记不清）。
groups.result: 成功解密 RTON 资源文件，并查看其中可读取的数据。
groups.gaps: 这是个人学习，不是工作。不声称自研解密算法、破解 Rijndael/AES，或发现经发行方确认的漏洞。具体步骤已记不清，不做补写。不公开密钥、IV 和专有游戏数据，也不把他人的发现算作自己的成果。
groups.proof: 本站暂未公开相关作品。
